title: Throw-in straight into goal
scenario: Red is attacking Blue's goal. A Red player takes a throw-in near the Blue penalty area and throws the ball directly into Blue's goal without it touching any other player.

title: Reckless trip in box, no DOGSO
scenario: Red is attacking Blue's goal. Inside Blue's penalty area, a Red attacker is dribbling away from goal toward the corner flag with no goal-scoring opportunity. A Blue defender trips the attacker with a reckless challenge.

title: Goal direct from kick-off
scenario: Red takes the kick-off. The Red player kicks the ball from the centre mark and it flies directly into Blue's goal without touching anyone else.

title: Defender deflects over goal line
scenario: Red is attacking Blue's goal. A Red shot is deflected by a Blue defender and the ball goes wholly over Blue's goal line, wide of the posts.

title: Off-ball punch
scenario: The ball is in play near Red's penalty area. In midfield, away from the ball and outside both penalty areas, a Blue player deliberately punches a Red player in the face.

title: Offside from a throw-in
scenario: Red is attacking Blue's goal. A Red player standing in an offside position receives the ball directly from a Red teammate's throw-in and runs toward goal.

title: Keeper handles a back-pass
scenario: Inside Blue's own penalty area, a Blue defender deliberately kicks the ball back to the Blue goalkeeper, who picks it up with their hands. No goal-scoring opportunity is denied.

title: Offside reset by defender's deliberate play
scenario: Red is attacking Blue's goal. A Red forward is in an offside position. A Blue defender, under no pressure, deliberately tries to pass the ball to a teammate but miskicks it, and the ball runs to the Red forward. It was not a deliberate save.

title: Free-kick double touch
scenario: Red takes a direct free kick in midfield. The ball moves a short distance, then the same Red kicker kicks it a second time before any other player has touched it.

title: Penalty rebound off post, kicker again
scenario: Red takes a penalty kick. The ball hits the post and rebounds to the Red kicker, who shoots again before any other player has touched the ball.

title: Substitute enters and stops pass
scenario: A Red substitute sitting on the bench runs onto the field without the referee's permission and stops a Blue pass in Red's half, outside the penalty area, while the ball is in play.

title: Dropped ball in the penalty area
scenario: The ball is inside Blue's penalty area, last touched by a Red attacker, when the referee stops play for a serious injury. No offence occurred.

title: Keeper holds ball > 8 seconds
scenario: Blue's goalkeeper catches the ball inside their own penalty area and holds it in their hands for more than eight seconds.

title: Free kick into own goal
scenario: Red is awarded a direct free kick in its own half. The Red player takes it and the ball goes directly into Red's own goal without touching any other player.

title: DOGSO in box, attempt to play ball
scenario: Red is attacking Blue's goal. Inside Blue's penalty area, a Blue defender makes a genuine attempt to play the ball but trips a Red attacker, denying an obvious goal-scoring opportunity.

title: Accidental handball goes in
scenario: Red is attacking Blue's goal. A cross accidentally hits a Red attacker's arm, and the ball goes straight into Blue's goal from the arm.

title: Throw-in countdown expires
scenario: Red has a throw-in near halfway. The Red player with the ball keeps delaying, so the referee whistles and starts a visual five-second countdown. The five seconds run out and the throw-in still has not been taken.

title: Goal-kick countdown expires
scenario: Blue has a goal kick. The Blue goalkeeper keeps delaying taking it, so the referee whistles and starts a visual five-second countdown. The five seconds run out and the goal kick still has not been taken.

title: Penalty accidental double touch, scored
scenario: Red takes a penalty kick during the match. The kicker slips and the ball accidentally touches their non-kicking foot immediately after the kick, then goes into Blue's goal. No other player offends.

title: Penalty accidental double touch, saved
scenario: Red takes a penalty kick during the match. The kicker slips and the ball accidentally touches their non-kicking foot immediately after the kick. The Blue goalkeeper, who stayed correctly on the goal line, saves it. No other player offends.

title: DOGSO advantage, goal scored
scenario: Red is attacking Blue's goal. Outside the penalty area, a Blue defender carelessly trips a Red attacker, denying an obvious goal-scoring opportunity. The ball runs to another Red attacker, the referee plays advantage, and that attacker immediately scores.

title: Illegal throw-in, advantage played
scenario: Red takes a throw-in in midfield but lifts both feet off the ground as they throw. The ball goes straight to a Blue midfielder, who immediately starts a promising attack toward Red's goal.

title: Failed handball on goal line, goal
scenario: Red is attacking Blue's goal. A Red shot is heading into the net. A Blue defender on the goal line deliberately tries to stop it with their hand but only grazes it, and the ball still goes into the goal.

title: Double touch + keeper off line, saved
scenario: Red takes a penalty kick during the match. The kicker slips and the ball accidentally touches their non-kicking foot immediately after the kick. The Blue goalkeeper has moved off the goal line before the kick and saves the ball. It is the goalkeeper's first such offence in the match. No other player offends.

title: Dropped ball, ball about to go out
scenario: In midfield, a slow pass by a Red player is rolling toward the touchline with nobody near it and is clearly about to go out of play. Just before it crosses the line, the referee stops play for a serious head injury elsewhere. The ball was last touched by Red and no offence occurred.

title: DOGSO advantage, shot wide
scenario: Red is attacking Blue's goal. Outside the penalty area, a Blue defender carelessly trips a Red attacker, denying an obvious goal-scoring opportunity. The ball runs to another Red attacker and the referee plays advantage, but that attacker shoots wide over Blue's goal line.
